Custom transfer settings

Denser QRs and shorter display times can reduce successful reads. ACKs may arrive before a group finishes; the next group waits for confirmation of all its chunks.

Transport settings arrive from the sender. Keep the acknowledgment QR visible to its camera, including after the file has been received.

This receiver accepts one transfer at a time, up to 8 MiB. Press Start receiver again to receive another file.

Small ACK and control codes use this device’s independent correction setting. The receiver does not need to match the sender’s speed preset. Use the same deadline on both devices.
